payload.body: vc to all Utilz nodes: slot 133 is GOne. utilz-cc lands 0081 in the primary on 4aa86d6, and its seven files sit uncommitted there until its commit: CHANGELOG.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/developer-guide.md, opt/utilz/lib/common.sh, opt/utilz/lib/install.sh, opt/utilz/test/common_lib.bats and opt/utilz/test/install_lib.bats. Its commit step refuses on any move of HEAD, so until utilz-cc's END nobody commits anything to the primary, board records included. Bank them after. No git add -A or commit -a. Work in your own worktrees goes on as normal.
